title: Gift-tax to be charged on property gifted.
text:
30. Gift-tax to be charged on property gifted. — Gift-tax payable in respect of any gift comprising

immovable property shall be a first charge on that property but any such charge shall not affect the title of
a bona fide purchaser for valuable consideration without notice of the charge.

[6[31 Notice of demand. — When any tax, interest, penalty, fine or any other sum is payable in](javascript:ShowFootnote('ftn302dtmdiv6chp7');)

consequence of any order passed under this Act, the [Assessing Officer] shall serve upon the assessee a
notice of demand in the prescribed form specifying the sum so payable.]

32. Recovery of tax and penalties. — (1) Any amount specified as payable in a notice of demand

under section 31 shall be paid within [thirty days] of the service of the notice at the place and to the
person mentioned in the notice:

Provided that, where the [Assessing Officer] has any reason to believe that it will be detrimental to

revenue if the full period of [thirty days] aforesaid is allowed, he may, with the previous approval of the
[8[ 9[Joint] Commissioner], direct that the sum specified in the notice of demand shall be paid within such](javascript:ShowFootnote('ftn309dtmdiv6chp7');)
period being a period less than the period of [thirty days] aforesaid, as may be specified by him in the
notice of demand.
